venues.name: Venues
venues.description: Event venues, outdoor spaces, private dining rooms, and corporate / conference settings.
venues.longCopy: The space sets the tone before guests arrive. Vendora venues range from architectural lofts and historic estates to outdoor gardens, restaurant private rooms, and corporate / conference spaces — each chosen for personality and operational reliability.

food-beverage.name: Food & Beverage
food-beverage.description: Catering, mobile bars, dessert programs, and food trucks for events of any size.
food-beverage.longCopy: From plated tasting menus to family-style feasts, mobile bars to dessert tables — the food and drink layer of an event done by teams that take it seriously.

entertainment.name: Entertainment
entertainment.description: DJs, live music, performers, and hosts who run the room.
entertainment.longCopy: Music and performance set the energy. Vendora entertainment runs the full arc — ceremony to last call — with curated DJs, live bands and ensembles, performers, and hosts / MCs who keep events on time and engaged.

media.name: Media
media.description: Photography, videography, and photo booths — the people who document the night.
media.longCopy: From editorial documentary photography to cinematic event films and open-air photo booths, the Media category covers everyone with a camera. Pair coverage types for full-event documentation.

design-decor.name: Design & Decor
design-decor.description: Coordinators, florists, beauty teams, decor rentals, and grooming services.
design-decor.longCopy: The visual and production layer — planners and day-of coordinators, florists, decor rentals, hair + makeup, and grooming. The teams who turn a room into a setting.

rentals.name: Rentals
rentals.description: Furniture, tents, lighting & AV, dance floors & staging, and transportation.
rentals.longCopy: Event-day infrastructure — furniture, tenting, lighting and AV, dance floors and staging, and guest transportation. Coordinated with your planner so deliveries hit the right windows.

experiences.name: Experiences
experiences.description: Tastings, cigar rollers, coffee carts, and other specialty experiences.
experiences.longCopy: The memorable extras — wine and whiskey tastings, cigar rollers, coffee carts, and specialty services that turn a dinner into a story.

corporate-services.name: Corporate Services
corporate-services.description: Staffing, speakers / hosts, security, and valet for corporate and large events.
corporate-services.longCopy: B2B essentials — service staff, professional speakers and hosts, licensed security, and valet for events that need controlled entry, scheduled programs, or large-scale logistics.
